Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Jun 24, 10:32 am, Oortje <internetoor...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Do I get the edge from Sargons ability before or after the referendum of a political action he attempts?

After.
He hasn't successfully performed the action until the action is
complete.
